items.title: agent-desktop tops the day's star count with 2,463 more
items.summary:
vercel labs' rust cli drives desktop apps through their accessibility trees instead of guessing from screenshots.
it added 2,463 stars today for 14,409 total, up 1,313 since this morning, with no new push since 23:16 utc on tuesday.

items.title: nvidia's auto-ontology lands on trending at 2,053 stars today
items.summary:
it builds a semantic graph layer over messy data so agents can reason over entities and relations instead of raw rows.
it is at 4,233 stars total and was pushed at 15:04 utc today, so the repo is being worked on while it trends.

items.title: scrapling climbs to 2,006 stars a day after its spike
items.summary:
scrapling puts a single request, a stealth browser session and a full crawl behind one python api.
it added 2,006 stars today for 96,061 total, up about 1,000 on yesterday evening, and was pushed at 14:08 utc.

items.title: discimagestudio appears with 1,792 stars and no description
items.summary:
it is a c# repo with no description that has hit trending anyway, which is the whole story here.
it added 1,792 stars today for 6,198 total and was pushed at 07:27 utc, but the repo still has no description.

items.title: mattpocock's skills folder adds 1,376 stars
items.summary:
it is a plain directory of agent skills copied straight from the author's own dot-agents setup.
it added 1,376 stars for 312,670 total and was pushed at 11:45 utc today.

items.title: claude-mem keeps its run going with 1,165 stars today
items.summary:
claude-mem records a session, compresses it with a model and injects the useful parts into later runs.
it added 1,165 stars for 112,573 total and was pushed at 08:19 utc today.

items.title: floci stays on the list with 1,082 stars for a free aws emulator
items.summary:
floci is a local java emulator for aws services, pitched as a lighter alternative to localstack.
it added 1,082 stars to reach 29,366 and was pushed at 16:02 utc, minutes before this build.

items.title: spec-kit lands on trending with 810 stars
items.summary:
github's spec-driven development kit turns a written spec into plans and tasks an agent can execute.
it added 810 stars today for 147,099 total and was pushed at 15:45 utc.

items.title: democrats take both chambers and iran calls it a vote against the war
items.summary:
democrats won the house and senate, and trump told fox the war was "part of it" while insisting he would do it again.
iran's speaker said americans voted "no to war" and warned of a "nightmare", while khamenei said us hostility will not change with a new congress.
items.change: the house and senate both flipped, so democrats can push a binding war powers resolution that would direct trump to end the war.

items.title: jpost: the aid cut could shake gulf trust in us commitments
items.summary:
a middle east analyst told the jerusalem post that ending aid to israel without coordinating first reads as washington retreating from the region.
israeli officials still say trump misspoke on tuesday, and netanyahu's office has not corrected the claim that payments stop by december.
items.change: the story moved from a vague correction to an open question about whether gulf states still trust us security guarantees.

items.title: iran says it is ready for a new attack and threatens a wider response
items.summary:
khamenei warned a renewed us attack would draw a broader response, pointing to iran's hold on hormuz and its strikes on us bases.
tehran's "maximum deterrence" plan was already ready before the vote, and the midterms did not slow the messaging.
items.change: khamenei's statement after the vote explicitly warned of "broader retaliation" rather than the earlier general threat.

items.title: irgc says four tankers burned in hormuz, bbc verify finds no proof
items.summary:
the irgc said four oil tankers hit sea mines and caught fire, two still burning, and that two more were intercepted on a banned route.
bbc verify said it has found no evidence four tankers were destroyed, while ukmto logged one ship hit by two projectiles 14nm off limah.
items.change: the irgc raised its claim from two tankers yesterday to four burning today, and added a claim that it downed another us mq-9.

items.title: the idf says it killed seven gaza operatives, one a hostage-taker
items.summary:
the idf and shin bet said strikes earlier this week killed seven fighters in gaza, including gamal abu said, who held a hostage.
six of them died near khan younis and came from hamas, jaish al-islam and islamic jihad, the military said.
items.change: gaza was not in yesterday's brief; today the idf named the targets, including the man it says held omar shem tov.

items.title: israel certifies the result and herzog starts coalition talks
items.summary:
the elections committee confirmed the final count and rejected netanyahu's fraud claims, and the attorney general blocked shin bet interrogations.
herzog began consultations at the president's residence, with religious zionist first to recommend netanyahu, after a security alert delayed the start.
items.change: the count is now official and rejected the fraud claims, so the fight moved from the count to who herzog asks to form a government.

items.title: yemen's government pushes deeper into al-jawf's al-dahida heights
items.summary:
troops backed by jets and drones stormed houthi positions in the al-dahida range a day after claiming the high ground.
the advance comes as fighting picks up in al-dhale, lahij and taiz, where a houthi siege has trapped civilians.
items.change: the government held the heights overnight and is now clearing houthi barracks and depots inside the range.

items.title: the asian cup 2027 in saudi arabia is pushed from january to december
items.summary:
the afc moved the start from 7 january to december 2027, citing houthi attacks on the host country.
it is the biggest scheduled event to shift so far, and it lands while riyadh is still answering missile and drone alerts.
items.change: the tournament date was announced as january and is now december 2027.

items.title: stocks rip after the sweep as gridlock trade takes over
items.summary:
the dow jumped 2.5% and the s&p 500 1.4% as democrats took both chambers and trump accepted the result without a fight.
the vix fell 16.6% to 17.37, and bank, health insurer and solar names led while the ai buildout sold off.

items.title: data centre stocks crack as texas elects a moratorium governor
items.summary:
gina hinojosa won texas on a promise to halt new data centres, and investors marked down the power and neocloud complex.
vertiv fell 11.8%, ge vernova 11.3% and constellation 8%, with the neocloud etf down 6% and coreweave 7%.

items.title: the magnificent seven split as apple and microsoft run
items.summary:
apple rose 6.5% and microsoft 6.2% with alphabet 4.5% and amazon 7%, bucking the wider ai selloff.
the exceptions were tesla at -2.3% and nvidia at -1.5%, so the chip and data centre side of ai lagged the platforms.

items.title: brent falls below $101 as the war trade unwinds
items.summary:
brent dropped 2.7% to $100.82 and wti 2.7% to $93.52 as traders read the vote as a check on new strikes.
eia crude stocks fell 865,000 barrels against a build expected, which would normally support prices and did not.

items.title: mcdonald's and uber beat, cvs splits and drops 11%
items.summary:
mcdonald's eps beat by 19 cents on a revenue miss, uber beat on revenue, and novo jumped 6% on wegovy pill sales.
cvs fell 11% on a plan to split off its drugstores and reverse the aetna deal, while duolingo rose 31%.

items.title: adp holds at 86,000 jobs and ism services slips to 54.5
items.summary:
private hiring came in at 86,000, the same as the revised september figure and above forecasts of about 70,000.
ism services eased to 54.5 from 54.9 and its prices index stayed high at 73, keeping the fed hike argument alive.

items.title: the next debt ceiling fight is now the market's main political risk
items.summary:
democrats are preparing to use the debt limit to extract concessions from trump, and analysts expect a long standoff.
a miss on payments would hit treasury markets first, and the deficit is running at $1.99 trillion this year.

items.title: gold and silver jump even as stocks rally
items.summary:
spot gold rose 2.9% to about $4,043 and silver 4.4% to $51.98 as traders bought hedges against the new congress.
the move came alongside a flat 10-year at 4.954%, which points to policy risk rather than a rates story.

items.title: liverpool take a perfect european record to istanbul tonight
items.summary:
liverpool face fenerbahce at 20:45 riyadh with three wins from three in the champions league league phase.
they are unbeaten in europe but lost their last league game to arsenal, and the hosts changed coach on tuesday night.

items.title: fenerbahce appointed emre belozoglu hours before kickoff
items.summary:
fenerbahce named the former captain as coach on tuesday night after ismail kartal left and dirk kuyt held the job briefly.
belozoglu joins from kasimpasa with the club sixth on 16 points, nine behind galatasaray.

items.title: gravenberch has a fractured heel and is out in istanbul
items.summary:
iraola said the midfielder has a heel fracture and was left at the axa centre, with sunday's trip to palace uncertain.
he felt it warming up against arsenal, and with palace on sunday the club chose not to risk the flight.

items.title: szoboszlai and munoz are in a 22-man squad with eight out
items.summary:
liverpool named a 22-man squad for istanbul with eight players missing, and szoboszlai and munoz both included after injury doubts.
frimpong, ekitike and leoni are still out, so iraola's options at the back and on the bench are thinner than the results suggest.

items.title: liverpool are close to a new deal for trey nyoni
items.summary:
talks with the 19-year-old's representatives are advanced after his first premier league start against arsenal.
the club turned down a £30m offer from nottingham forest in the summer and did not replace curtis jones, betting on him.

items.title: bournemouth visit anfield in the carabao cup on 16 december
items.summary:
the quarter-final is set for wednesday 16 december at 20:00 gmt, shown on itv and sky in the uk.
it sits in a run of six games in 18 days, which is why rotation in istanbul matters more than usual.

items.title: will wright's hat-trick gives the u19s a 5-3 win in istanbul
items.summary:
wright scored twice in the first 15 minutes and sealed his treble in the second half as liverpool won the youth league tie 5-3.
it is his second european hat-trick this season, with sonni-lambie and inglethorpe also scoring.

items.title: chiesa's exit edges closer as trent is tipped for an anfield return
items.summary:
the echo reports federico chiesa is moving towards the exit, with talk of a trent alexander-arnold return growing.
both are echo reporting and fan speculation, not club confirmations, so treat them as unconfirmed for now.
